messages:
anya_csm: Heads-up: SummitPay flagged an org expansion — 3 new product teams (recommendation, fraud, docs-qa) want to onboard starting May 12. They expect ~4x token throughput during business hours. Can we pre-provision or recommend a Dedicated pilot?

mike_infra: Thanks — can you share current qps and expected peak per team? Also which models/regions they plan to use?

anya_csm: Current prod avg ~120 rps (tokens ~40k/day). They estimate peak ~480 rps during 09:00-11:00 PST and 16:00-18:00 PST. Mix is embeddings (~60%) + chat completions (~40%). Primary region: us-west, small eu subset for docs-qa. No private infra requested yet.

josh_sales: Renewal in ~3 months — big upsell if we nail capacity and onboarding. I can push for Dedicated pilot in the renewal bundle. :star-struck:

natalie_success: Onboarding plan idea: 2-week enablement + sandbox with a curated prompt set and perf test. Need engineering to pre-provision a sandbox cluster and a sample token budget for testing. @mike_infra any ETA if we ask for a short burst reservation?

mike_infra: I'll run a quick capacity scan now and tag infra-bot for numbers. Can we get expected model sizes (e.g., 7B vs 70B) and whether embeddings are batched?

anya_csm: They want to use a 13B open model for chat and 2x quantized embedder for embeddings. Embeddings will be batched by client; assume batching up to 64.

infra-bot: capacity-scan: available GPU nodes=14, spare capacity for burst=~30%. Estimated latency impact under 4x sustained load: +20–30ms average. Recommend enabling autoscale + prefix/KV cache. run_id=`run-20240503-27`.

mike_infra: Good. With autoscale + KV prefix cache and batching window 10ms we can absorb the 4x peak with <35ms p50 delta. I'll open a provisioning ticket and enable a temporary burst reservation for them.

mike_infra: Opening ticket ENG-4321 with initial estimates and playbook checklist. ETA: 48 hours to pre-provision sandbox + add to Dedicated pilot waitlist. Link: https://redwood.internal/eng/tickets/ENG-4321

anya_csm: Perfect — please tag me on the ticket and add enablement tasks. I'll confirm customer timeline after today's call.

josh_sales: I'll prepare renewal upsell language and pricing scenarios (3-month pilot -> conversion to committed capacity).

natalie_success: I'll draft the multi-team onboarding playbook and sample prompts for embeddings/chat. Will share a first draft by EOD Friday. :memo:

mike_infra: Noted. Closing loop here once ENG-4321 has the provisioning PR and autoscale toggles.

anya_csm: Thanks everyone — this feels like a clear expansion signal. I'll log next steps in the account health doc and follow up with the customer timeline.
